# Coupon fixture: coupon_20x20x60.stl

## Description
A single axis-aligned rectangular prism, 20 mm (X) x 20 mm (Y) x 60 mm (Z), sitting on the build plate at Z=0 and centred on X=0, Y=0 (so it spans X in [-10, 10], Y in [-10, 10], Z in [0, 60]).

## Exact dimensions
- X extent: -10.0 mm to 10.0 mm (20 mm)
- Y extent: -10.0 mm to 10.0 mm (20 mm)
- Z extent: 0.0 mm to 60.0 mm (60 mm)
- Triangles: 12 (2 per face x 6 faces)
- Format: binary STL, deterministic fixed ASCII header, no timestamps

## Purpose
This is the M0 test fixture: the simplest possible watertight solid used to prove the slicing-pipeline plugin hook fires correctly (M0 hook proof) before any structural slot logic exists. It also serves as the base geometry for the M1 single-slot coupon, where a single boundary-connected slot will be subtracted from this prism's per-layer 2D slices to validate the plugin's Boolean/topology pipeline end to end.

Generated by `tools/make_fixtures.py coupon`.
